title: promptfrenzy.take-creator-link input
description: Payload for POST https://www.promptfrenzy.com/api/creators/claim: one creator taking one tracked link. Mirrors the live server contract (lib/referrals/creator-deal.ts, parseCreatorClaim).

handle.description: The creator's handle; it becomes the link (?via=<handle>). 2 to 30 characters: letters, digits, dot and underscore. A leading @ is dropped and capitals are lowered. A handle that does not fit is refused, never trimmed into another one.

channel_url.description: Where the creator teaches or posts: a channel, profile or site. A web address of at most 300 characters; https:// is added when missing.

contact_email.description: The creator's email. Pro goes to the confirmed PromptFrenzy account that uses this address, so it must be the creator's own. One link per email.
